description: AI-powered COBOL mainframe modernization platform with 11 MCP tools, 3 resources, and 3 prompts. Parse copybooks, assess CICS integrations, scan JCL batch jobs, map VSAM files, translate EBCDIC, bridge ISO 20022 payments, run post-quantum cryptography assessments, fingerprint regulatory compliance (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA), discover COBOL codebases, generate REST APIs from COBOL, and automate test suites. Includes migration guides, API references, and modernization assessment prompts for enterprise mainframe-to-cloud transitions.

apiKey.description: Optional API key for authenticated access

outputFormat.description: Preferred output format for tool results (json or text)

tools.name: cobol.transform.records
tools.description: Parse COBOL copybooks into structured JSON with field types, sizes, and hierarchy. Extracts PIC clauses, REDEFINES, OCCURS, and 88-level conditions.

copybook.description: Raw COBOL copybook source text to parse

tools.name: cobol.analyze.transactions
tools.description: Analyze CICS transaction programs for API bridge compatibility. Identifies EXEC CICS commands, BMS maps, COMMAREA structures, and modernization complexity.

tools.name: cobol.analyze.jobs
tools.description: Scan JCL job streams to extract step dependencies, dataset usage, program calls, and scheduling metadata for batch modernization planning.

tools.name: cobol.discover.copybooks
tools.description: Map VSAM file structures (KSDS, ESDS, RRDS) to modern database schemas. Generates SQL DDL, index recommendations, and migration scripts.

definition.description: VSAM IDCAMS DEFINE or cluster definition

tools.name: cobol.transform.encoding
tools.description: Translate EBCDIC-encoded data to ASCII/UTF-8 with support for packed decimal (COMP-3), binary (COMP), and zoned decimal conversions.

encoding.description: Encoding type of the input data

tools.name: bridge.output.payments
tools.description: Transform legacy payment messages from MT (SWIFT) to MX (ISO 20022) format. Generates pacs, camt, and pain message types with compliance validation and migration tracking.

mtMessage.description: SWIFT MT message content (MT103, MT202, etc.)

tools.name: bridge.validate.encryption
tools.description: Assess cryptographic posture of COBOL systems for post-quantum readiness. Inventories crypto usage, maps to NIST-approved PQC algorithms (CRYSTALS-Kyber, CRYSTALS-Dilithium, SPHINCS+), and generates migration roadmaps.

source.description: COBOL source code or system configuration to analyze

standard.description: PQC standard framework to assess against

tools.name: bridge.validate.compliance
tools.description: Map COBOL systems to 76+ global regulations including DORA, GDPR, Basel III, SOX, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, and MiFID II. Performs gap analysis and generates compliance evidence documentation.

source.description: COBOL source code or system documentation to fingerprint

tools.name: cobol.discover.programs
tools.description: AI-powered COBOL codebase discovery and cataloging. Performs dependency mapping, complexity analysis (cyclomatic, Halstead), dead code detection, and generates comprehensive modernization inventory.

tools.name: bridge.output.interface
tools.description: Generate REST, GraphQL, and gRPC API definitions from COBOL copybooks and program interfaces. Produces OpenAPI 3.0 specs, GraphQL schemas, and Protocol Buffer definitions.

copybook.description: COBOL copybook or WORKING-STORAGE to generate API from

serviceName.description: Name for the generated API service

tools.name: bridge.output.tests
tools.description: Capture COBOL program behavior as test baselines and detect regressions with intelligent diffing. Generates test cases from production data patterns, validates I/O transformations, and creates regression test suites.

source.description: COBOL program source code to generate tests for

prompts.name: modernization-assessment
prompts.description: Complete COBOL modernization assessment with risk scoring and migration roadmap

arguments.name: programSource
arguments.description: COBOL source code or program description to assess

prompts.name: iso20022-migration
prompts.description: Plan and execute ISO 20022 MT to MX migration for SWIFT messages

arguments.name: messageType
arguments.description: SWIFT MT message type (e.g., MT103, MT202, MT940)

arguments.name: sampleMessage
arguments.description: Optional sample MT message for conversion testing

prompts.name: security-audit
prompts.description: Full security audit including PQC readiness, regulatory compliance, and vulnerability assessment

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: System, application, or COBOL program to audit
